nodes.description: State variable 'winner' holding the address of the winning whitelist member in GiveawayWinner.
EnumerableSet.AddressSet 'whitelist' storing all whitelisted participant addresses.
EnumerableSet.UintSet 'winnerIndices' storing indices that already won, preventing duplicate winners.
Private state variable '_owner' in Ownable recording the contract owner.
External onlyOwner function that loops over the whitelist, derives a pseudo-random index and marks a new winner.
Private view function '_random(uint256 salt)' deriving a value from block.difficulty, block.timestamp, salt and whitelist contents.
External onlyOwner function adding a single address to the whitelist.
External onlyOwner function removing a single address from the whitelist.
External onlyOwner function adding an array of addresses to the whitelist in a loop.
External onlyOwner function deleting the entire whitelist set.
onlyOwner modifier that requires owner() == _msgSender() before executing the guarded function.
Context internal function '_msgSender()' returning msg.sender.
Public onlyOwner function transferring ownership to a new address.
Public onlyOwner function renouncing ownership by transferring to address(0).
Public view function returning the current owner address.
msg.sender, attacker-controllable caller identity used for access control checks.
block.timestamp, miner/validator-influenceable input used in the randomness derivation.
Weak randomness computation keccak256(abi.encodePacked(block.difficulty, block.timestamp, salt, ...)) that is predictable/manipulable by block producers.
require(owner() == _msgSender()) access-control gate that reverts when the caller is not the owner.
Parameter 'salt' of _random(uint256 salt) used as extra entropy in the hash.
Local variable 'salt' in findNewWinner, incremented on each loop iteration that yields an already-winning index.
Local variable 'n' in findNewWinner holding whitelist.length().
Loop counter 'i' in findNewWinner.
Local variable 'index' in findNewWinner, the candidate winning index produced by _random(salt) % n.
Parameter '_address' of whiteListAddress(address _address).
Parameter '_address' of removeWhiteListedAddress(address _address).
Parameter '_address' array of whiteListMultipleAddress(address[] calldata _address).
Local variable 'n' in whiteListMultipleAddress holding _address.length.
Loop counter 'i' in whiteListMultipleAddress.
Parameter 'newOwner' of transferOwnership(address newOwner).
Local variable 'oldOwner' in _transferOwnership caching the previous owner for the event.
Internal function '_transferOwnership(address newOwner)' that writes the _owner state variable and emits OwnershipTransferred.

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by _msgSender(), making the caller identity the source of the ownership authorization data.
msg.sender (via _msgSender) feeds the onlyOwner comparison that gates privileged functions.
The value returned by _msgSender() is compared against owner() inside the require access-control check.
block.timestamp flows into the keccak256 randomness expression, making the outcome timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is consumed by _random, so the function result depends on miner-controllable time.
The salt parameter is packed into the hash inside _random.
The local salt counter is passed into _random and incremented within findNewWinner.
Local n = whitelist.length() bounds the loop and is the modulus base for the index computation.
Loop counter i drives iteration of the winner search.
Local index value is checked against winnerIndices and then used to select the winner.
The whitelist set is read (length, at) while searching for a new winner.
winnerIndices is read via contains() to reject already-selected indices and written via add().
_random hashes whitelist._inner._values, so the set contents are part of the random seed.
findNewWinner writes the winner state variable with the selected whitelist address.
The _address parameter is added to the whitelist set in whiteListAddress.
The _address parameter is removed from the whitelist set in removeWhiteListedAddress.
Elements of the _address array parameter are added to the whitelist set.
Local n = _address.length bounds the batch whitelisting loop.
Loop counter i iterates over the input address array.
The newOwner parameter is forwarded to _transferOwnership after the zero-address check.
Local oldOwner caches the previous _owner value before it is overwritten in _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership writes the _owner state variable.
whiteListAddress mutates the whitelist state variable.
removeWhiteListedAddress mutates the whitelist state variable.
whiteListMultipleAddress mutates the whitelist state variable.
removeAllAddress deletes all entries of the whitelist state variable.
The onlyOwner modifier guards execution of findNewWinner.
The onlyOwner modifier guards execution of whiteListAddress.
The onlyOwner modifier guards execution of removeWhiteListedAddress.
The onlyOwner modifier guards execution of whiteListMultipleAddress.
The onlyOwner modifier guards execution of removeAllAddress.
The onlyOwner modifier evaluates the owner equality require check before running the guarded body.
findNewWinner calls _random to obtain the candidate index on each loop iteration.
The weak randomness computation is performed inside _random using timestamp and difficulty.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership delegates the ownership write to _transferOwnership.
renounceOwnership delegates the ownership write to _transferOwnership with address(0).

normalization_plan.reason: The 'salt' parameter only exists to feed the hash computation in _random and carries no independent semantic role.
The local 'salt' counter is loop-local bookkeeping for the randomness retry and can be collapsed into findNewWinner.
Local 'n' is a transient bound (whitelist.length()) used only inside the findNewWinner loop.
Loop counter 'i' is ephemeral iteration state of findNewWinner.
Local 'index' is a temporary candidate value used only within findNewWinner.
The _address parameter is directly consumed by the whitelist.add call of whiteListAddress.
The _address parameter is directly consumed by the whitelist.remove call of removeWhiteListedAddress.
The _address array parameter is the sole input iterated and added by whiteListMultipleAddress.
Local 'n' is a transient bounds value equal to _address.length inside the batch loop.
Loop counter 'i' is ephemeral iteration state of whiteListMultipleAddress.
The newOwner parameter is validated and immediately forwarded to _transferOwnership by transferOwnership.
Local 'oldOwner' is a transient cache of the previous owner used only for the event in _transferOwnership.
